items.summary_zh: SunEditor 淨化器處理不當，導致攻擊者可注入惡意腳本。
items.fix_hint: 升級至 2.47.11 或更新版本
items.desc_en: SunEditor is a lightweight and powerful WYSIWYG editor in vanilla JavaScript with no dependencies. Prior to 2.47.11, the sanitizer in src/lib/core.js does not consistently reject namespaced or custom HTML elements, allowing event-handler attributes to remain on crafted elements. When an application renders attacker-controlled editor content and a user interacts with the element, the retained handler can execute script in the application's browser origin, enabling stored cross-site scripting, data exposure, or unauthorized browser-context actions. This issue is fixed in version 2.47.11.

items.summary_zh: 安裝程式洩漏 Google Cloud 私鑰，導致雲端資源遭冒用。
items.fix_hint: 請參閱官方安全公告進行更新
items.desc_en: ZohoCorp ManageEngine Applications Manager versions 182200 and below were vulnerable to exposure of a Google Cloud service-account private key in the Applications Manager installer, which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to impersonate the service account and access or modify associated cloud resources.

items.summary_zh: L2TP 參數處理不當導致越界寫入，可遠端觸發 RCE。
items.desc_en: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-825 3.00b32. Affected is the function tunnel_set_params of the file tunnel.c of the component rp-l2tp. The manipulation of the argument peer_hostname  leads to out-of-bounds write. The attack may be initiated remotely.

items.summary_zh: 通知設定檔模組存在漏洞，允許遠端執行任意程式碼。

items.desc_en: ZohoCorp ManageEngine OpManager MSP versions 12.8.709 and below were vulnerable to a Remote Code Execution vulnerability in the Notification Profile module.

items.summary_zh: 一般使用者可寫入惡意內容，導致權限提升與程式碼執行。
